title: Pool swimwear dialogue portraits, round 1
question: Which swimwear set should each of Kuro, Emi, Eric and Carina use for the pool dialogue, if any?

media.caption: Pictures for the day 3 pool dialogue (#633), so the portraits wear the swimwear the 3D bodies wear. Each is the approved portrait with only the clothes repainted (face, hair, glasses and framing kept), the suit matched to the picked 3D body: Kuro dark navy, Emi muted teal, Carina burgundy one-pieces, Eric bare chest and navy shorts. No caps or wet hair, as the models have none. At the size the game shows portraits (1080p desktop: every face the same height, chins level, cut at the waist, Kuro at her 0.85 size). For each person: the portraits now, then the swimwear sets I kept, each row ending with the approved 3D swimwear body from reviews/pool-swimwear-1 for comparison.
Kuro: every attempt in order, framed as the game crops it, after her approved portrait. Passes a to e on her neutral, then her four other faces with the e2 settings.
Emi: every attempt in order (passes a to f).
Eric: every attempt in order (passes a to j), then his surprised and tired faces with the j1 and j4 settings.
Carina: every attempt in order (passes a to e), then her surprised and tired faces with the e2 and e3 settings.
